findings.summary: Rust calls-edge confidence was upgraded to EXTRACTED but weight was left at 0.8, inconsistent with the EXTRACTED/1.0 pairing used everywhere else.
findings.mechanism: extract_rust's calls edge now emits confidence="EXTRACTED" with weight=0.8, while every other extractor (generic, Go, Zig, PowerShell, Objective-C, Elixir) pairs EXTRACTED with weight=1.0. This breaks the stated invariant that EXTRACTED implies weight 1.0, and any downstream logic keying confidence tiers to specific weights will misrank/misweight Rust call edges relative to identical edges in other languages.
